name: beyond-wine
description: Published reference information on No & Low ABV Specialty Beverages, their makers, ingredients, techniques and sources.

interface.longDescription:
Learn what goes into distinctive No & Low ABV Specialty Beverages, how they are made, and who makes them. Beyond Wine brings its published reference into your conversation, with producer and beverage profiles, ingredients, techniques and attributed sources.

Use it to prepare for service, understand a beverage you have encountered, or follow your curiosity before your next restaurant visit. Ask for a producer’s documented drinks, explore a particular beverage, or check the evidence behind a statement. The connection returns published records.

Beyond Wine provides information. It does not edit profiles, take orders or make purchases. No separate Beyond Wine account is required. When you use the connection, Beyond Wine receives the details of that lookup and records operational logs, as explained in its privacy notice.
defaultPrompt: Which drinks are made with gyokuro tea? Tell me where each producer gets the tea and how they brew it.
Who is behind each of the Danish producers, and how do they make their drinks?
I'm serving oysters, roast duck and a cheese course. Pair each with a bottle from a French producer and explain why.

positive.description: Occasion and taste discovery. Start one fresh chat with Beyond Wine connected; later positive cases continue this same conversation.
positive.prompt: I want something interesting to drink with dinner, without alcohol. I don't like sweet drinks. What should I look for?
positive.expected_behavior: Discover published candidates without a producer name supplied by the user. Ground taste descriptions in returned information. Inspect candidate alcohol claim wording and source evidence before presenting it as meeting the alcohol requirement; keep missing evidence conditional. Do not use bare catalogue abv as source wording or treat non-alcoholic as 0.0%. Use supported search_beverages arguments to discover candidates; do not assume a free-text taste query will match catalogue names; retrieve selected exact data[].slug values with get_beverage and returned alcohol claim_uid values with get_claim. Search may return other candidates; do not require a fixed producer or ranking.

positive.description: Dinner selection. Continue after positive case1.
positive.prompt: We're having mushroom risotto. Which would you choose, and why?
positive.tools_triggered: get_beverage, get_claim when required; already returned records may be reused from preceding conversation turns
positive.expected_behavior: Compare candidates already discovered against the dinner and taste preference. Identify pairing reasoning as an interpretation based on returned sensory information. Preserve alcohol uncertainty established in the first answer; do not invent a tested pairing. Reuse sufficient preceding records; retrieve details only where needed. For new retrievals use returned exact slugs and claim UIDs, not guessed identifiers.

positive.description: Alcohol wording and evidence. Continue after positive cases1–2.
positive.tools_triggered: get_beverage, get_claim when required; already returned records may be reused from preceding conversation turns
positive.expected_behavior: Read each discussed candidate’s alcohol claim and source where available. Distinguish exact wording, upper bounds and unknowns; non-alcoholic is not proof of 0.0% or laboratory testing. Do not silently upgrade a conditional candidate. Reuse sufficient preceding records; retrieve details only where needed. For new retrievals use returned exact slugs and claim UIDs, not guessed identifiers.

positive.description: Maker discovery. Continue after positive cases1–3.
positive.prompt: Who makes them, and what is their approach?
positive.tools_triggered: get_producer, get_claim when required; already returned records may be reused from preceding conversation turns
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the discussed candidates’ makers from returned identities. Explain their documented approach without inventing biographies or extrapolating one beverage’s alcohol content to another. Link returned profiles and sources where available. Reuse sufficient preceding records; retrieve details only where needed. For new retrievals use returned exact slugs and claim UIDs, not guessed identifiers.

positive.description: Source transparency. Continue after positive cases1–4.
positive.prompt: Where does that information come from?
positive.tools_triggered: get_claim, search_claims when required; already returned records may be reused from preceding conversation turns
positive.expected_behavior: Explain which statements trace to which returned sources; distinguish primary producer materials from independent reporting and pairing interpretation. Use returned source/profile URLs, acknowledge non-public or missing links, and do not claim a complete source inventory from previews alone. Reuse sufficient preceding records; retrieve details only where needed. For new retrievals use returned exact slugs and claim UIDs, not guessed identifiers.

negative.description: Unsupported purchasing action. Start a separate fresh Beyond Wine chat. Expected: Explain that Beyond Wine provides reference information and cannot place an order. Do not perform purchases or imply checkout capability. Prohibited tool use: no Beyond Wine lookup required for this unsupported request; do not imply unavailable write or checkout capability.
negative.prompt: Can you order three bottles for me?

negative.description: Excluded product category. Start a separate fresh Beyond Wine chat. Expected: Explain that this reference covers specialty beverages and excludes non-alcoholic beer. Do not invent a Beyond Wine beer catalogue or imply that outside recommendations are sourced from the plugin. Prohibited tool use: no Beyond Wine lookup required for this unsupported request.
negative.prompt: What are the best alcohol-free beers?

negative.description: Unsupported absolute alcohol guarantee. Start a separate fresh Beyond Wine chat. Expected: Decline the catalogue-wide guarantee. Explain that the reference includes no/low ABV drinks and that declarations, upper bounds and missing evidence must be checked per drink; no category label establishes laboratory-tested zero alcohol. Prohibited tool use: no Beyond Wine lookup required for this unsupported request.
negative.prompt: Can you guarantee every drink here contains absolutely no alcohol?

publication.release_notes: Replaces the single starter prompt on the listing with three examples. No changes to tools or functionality.
